data.exact_reserve_text: The following tables show the estimates of cumulative incurred claims, including both claims notified and IBNR for each successive underwriting year at each reporting date, together with cumulative payments to date, related direct and indirect claims handling costs and, for the latest calendar year, the run-off provision representing management's estimated future developments to be incurred in finalising the Syndicate's liabilities. Balances have been translated at exchange rates prevailing at 31 December 2018 in all cases.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable development on older underwriting years resulting in a reduction of the recorded gross ultimate for the 2016 underwriting year.
Favourable development on the 2015 underwriting year resulting in a reduction in the gross ultimate estimate.
Minor adverse development on 2013 (small increase in the gross ultimate estimate).

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening (1 January 2018) gross claims outstanding was GBP 2.395m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 1.18m (a release), driven primarily by favourable movements on older underwriting years (notably 2015 and 2016) with a very small adverse movement on 2013. Management commentary notes high value claims on a binder in 2017 and the inclusion of a run-off provision following the decision to cease underwriting; overall the gross reserve movement measured from the development table is a material release versus opening reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: driven by a number of high value claims on a particular binder on the 2017 year of account in the earlier part of the year.
In addition, following the decision to cease underwriting, a run-off provision is included within the reserves of the Syndicate.
This follows adverse claims experience and an increase in the acquisition ratio along with a moderate movement in the expense ratio.

A run-off provision has been included within the technical provisions of the Syndicate representing management's best estimate assessment of the expected costs to be incurred in finalising the Syndicate's liabilities.

In arriving at the level of claims provisions a margin may be applied over and above the actuarial best estimate in line with the Syndicate's Reserving Policy to address the risk of un-modelled claims development.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was not stated as a single gross movement in the notes. A gross claims development triangle (note 20) was used to compute prior year development (method 4 fallback). The calculation excludes the two most recent underwriting years (2017, 2018) per the guidance. The syndicate subsequently accepted a reinsurance-to-close (Syndicate 779 into 2018) in post-period events which may distort future comparisons; RITC activity around the reporting year was identified and may affect comparability but the triangle used is reported at 31-Dec-2018. Values extracted from the triangle were reported in GBP '000 and converted to millions.
